integrity: The proof derives the first and second iterates exactly after positive diagonal scaling, identifies the only sign-indefinite coefficient, and analyzes its quadratic sign on the full parameter domain. The packaged exact-rational checker independently replays the finite algebra and witness; finite tests are not used to prove the all-parameter theorem.
scientific_limitations: The sharp three-halves threshold is proved for the second forward-SOR iterate on 2-by-2 symmetric positive definite Stieltjes systems started from zero. Later iterates, nonsymmetric M-matrices, symmetric SOR, and alternative orderings are not classified. The closest weak-regularity note was not available as verified full text, leaving a residual originality risk.
title: A sharp three-halves second-iterate positivity frontier for SOR
